items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: So we got Emma to play piano and we had Willie to come in there a while on clarinet, take George Lewis' place.

ctx.x: And Emma and Rick Howe played. Yeah. Then when Piku stood there, then when Piku, I think Piku's out of getting feeling kind of bad. He used to alternate. He'd be with his wildest faces, you know. Sometimes we couldn't get Piku where we might use the answer and then we'd use the Andrew Morgan. Piku?
